problem.title: How to parse json-file with spring batch?
problem.description: I have a list of serialized entities written to a file in json format. I need to read them from the file using spring batch (then process them and write to DB). I found only Flat file, DB and Xml readers provided with spring batch. What's the right way to parse json? The approach I'm going to implement is: 1. read the whole file with FlatFile reader 2. parse it with Jaxson in `read` method I'm completely newbie in spring batch, so I need a piece of advice here.
